0: A person signals to start using one arm with a dynamic motion, raising a fist and bending the forearm inward before returning.
1: A person signals to stop using one arm with a dynamic motion, raising an open palm across the body and moving the forearm sideways before returning.
2: A person signals to slow down using one arm with a dynamic motion, pressing the palm downward from chest level and returning.
3: A person signals to speed up using one arm with a dynamic motion, lifting the palm upward from the waist to chest level and lowering it back.
4: A person signals to move forward along the X-axis using two arms with a dynamic motion, showing one finger while the other hand pushes forward.
5: A person signals to move forward along the Y-axis using two arms with a dynamic motion, showing two fingers while the other hand pushes forward.
6: A person signals to move forward along the Z-axis using two arms with a dynamic motion, showing three fingers while the other hand pushes forward.
7: A person signals to move backward along the X-axis using two arms with a dynamic motion, showing one finger while the other arm pulls backward.
8: A person signals to move backward along the Y-axis using two arms with a dynamic motion, showing two fingers while the other arm pulls backward.
9: A person signals to move backward along the Z-axis using two arms with a dynamic motion, showing three fingers while the other arm pulls backward.
10: A person signals to rotate along the X-axis using two arms with a dynamic motion, showing one finger while the other hand rotates a fist.
11: A person signals to rotate along the Y-axis using two arms with a dynamic motion, showing two fingers while the other hand rotates a fist.
12: A person signals to rotate along the Z-axis using two arms with a dynamic motion, showing three fingers while the other hand rotates a fist.
13: A person signals to confirm completion using one arm with a static pose, holding a thumbs-up.
14: A person signals to pick up a part using one arm with a static pose, holding a grasping hand shape.
15: A person signals to deposit a part using one arm with a static pose, holding a clenched fist
